subject: Eval mission: Environment setup & networking cadence
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@latticehealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval mission: Environment setup & networking cadence

Hi Elena —

Following our intake call, I put together a concise MAP-oriented plan for the trial environment wiring so we can align on owners and cadence. Attached: MAP-commitments-v1.pdf and network-allowlist-template.csv. High level: 

- Org & access: create Redwood test org and invite Lattice evaluation admins (we'll provision scoped API keys). Owner: Lattice admin + Redwood SRE.
- API keys & roles: short-lived evaluation keys + token rotation guidance; we can generate keys the day after kickoff.
- IP allowlist: we will add Lattice egress IPs once you provide them (CSV attached).
- VPC peering: optional depending on your preference — requires CIDR ranges & a CloudOps contact; expect 2-4 business days once network tickets are opened.
- Security gating: SOC2 checklist items we flagged in the MAP doc; KMS/HSM integration is available if you need keys stored on your side.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Kickoff + org invite: within 48 hours of sign-off
- API keys issued: day 1 after org created
- Allowlist applied: within 24 hours of receiving IPs
- VPC peering negotiation & setup: 2-4 business days after network approval

Can you confirm: 1) primary cloud contact for peering, 2) legal/procurement owner who needs the MOU/draft, and 3) preferred kickoff window next week (we're free 4/13 10am PT or 4/14 2pm PT)?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP-commitments-v1.pdf, network-allowlist-template.csv

Subject: Re: Eval mission: Environment setup & networking cadence

Elena — thanks, and welcome Ryan.

On Sat, Apr 11, 2026 at 11:03 AM Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@latticehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Markus — this is helpful. Quick answers:
> - CloudOps contact for peering: Ryan Park (ryan@cloudops.io)
> - Procurement/legal: procurement@latticehealth.com
> - Security question: we will need the SOC2 excerpts and a note on whether Redwood can support customer-managed KMS for token storage.
>
Totally fine. Short answers: yes — we can provide SOC2 excerpt and a short security summary during kickoff. Customer-managed KMS is supported for Dedicated/Private deployments; for hosted evals we recommend using Redwood-managed keys but can discuss a KMS integration window if you require it for the trial.

Suggested concrete action items (post-kickoff):
- Markus: create Redwood eval org + invite Elena & product admins (day 0).
- Neha (infra lead): generate scoped API keys and publish rotation policy (day 1).
- Jonas (network SE): coordinate with Ryan to exchange CIDR & peering prerequisites; prepare peering playbook (2-4 business days).
- Legal/procurement: sign short-form MOU (we can accept DocuSign or a countersigned doc).

If 4/13 10am PT works, I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (20m): introductions, security gating, IP collection, timeline and immediate next steps.

—Markus
attachments: MAP-commitments-v1.pdf

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Lattice eval — owners & sprint-level tasks

Team — baseline workplan I can commit to once we have kickoff signoff. Keeping this internal so we have a single source of truth for owners.

Checklist / owners / estimated lead times:
- Org creation & admin invites: Markus to create (0-1 business day)
- Scoped API key generation: Neha to create and publish tokens to Alexander vault; keys expire in 7 days by default unless requested otherwise (1 business day)
- Allowlist application: need CSV from Lattice; once received, add to firewall rules and edge ingress (within 24 hours)
- VPC peering initiation: Jonas to open peering request with Ryan; expect network validations and route propagation — 2-3 business days after approval
- Smoke tests: Hannah to run token-auth smoke (list models, generate sample completions) and latency check (same region test) once API key is present (same day as keys)
- Security docs: Markus to provide SOC2 excerpt + short security brief; Neha to confirm KMS feasibility for trial (same day as kickoff)

Gating criteria to move from "onboarding" -> "trial-run": org created, at least one API key issued, allowlist applied OR peering completed, smoke tests pass.

We should aim for an evaluation start (trial-run) by 4/20 if legal signs MOU within the week. If legal drags, we can run a limited access hosted eval that doesn't require a countersigned MOU, but procurement prefers the short-form MOU.

Neha Kapoor
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
